runsOn: localhost, against the open Proxyman app

tools.name: get_flows
tools.description: Return recent HTTP flows from the open Proxyman session.

tools.name: filter_flows
tools.description: Filter captured flows. Combine conditions with and/or.

arguments.filters: Each item is { key, matching, value }. key is url, host, method, statusCode, requestHeader, responseHeader, requestBody, responseBody, or client.

tools.name: get_flow_detail
tools.description: Full request and response for one flow id from get_flows or filter_flows.

arguments.id: Flow id returned by get_flows or filter_flows.

tools.name: create_scripting_rule
tools.description: Create a Scripting rule. Handlers are onRequest(context, url, request) and onResponse(context, url, request, response). Return the request or the response.

tools.name: create_map_local
tools.description: Return a fixed response for matching requests instead of forwarding them.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.usedIn: Review — see what is already enabled
tools.description: List Map Local, Scripting, and other rules before adding another one.
